_comment: Changing a budget here automatically propagates to CI — no workflow
Upper limit for the 'First Load JS' column of any route reported
by `next build`.  500 kB gives room for the Stellar/Freighter SDK
while still being well inside Google's recommended ceiling.
Upper limit for 'First Load JS shared by all' — the cumulative
shared bundle that every page pays regardless of route.
Largest Contentful Paint threshold in milliseconds.  2500 ms maps
to Google's 'Good' boundary (≤ 2.5 s) for Core Web Vitals.

javascript.notes: Covers First-Load JS per route and the shared chunk. Increase only after a documented justification (ADR or issue comment).

lcp.notes: Google Core Web Vitals 'Good' threshold. Measured by Lighthouse CI against the production build served locally.

enforcement.notes: warnBeforePercent: a warning annotation is emitted (but the build does not fail) when usage exceeds 80% of a budget. This gives early visibility before a hard failure.

documentation.updateProcess: To increase a budget, open a PR that modifies this file, explains why the increase is justified, and is approved by a frontend maintainer.
